items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: 'We've out here a couple of times to talk to you, Lu...'

ctx.x: April 30, 1980. We've been talking to Danny, rappin' with him, and we've been down here for a couple of weeks and just enjoyed it. We've out here a couple of times to talk to you, Lu, and it's nice to see you doing so well. Danny made out a list of...what do you call it...? A genealogy which he's supplied. People in general that you're all related to. And I'm just looking down this list. What's your real name, Lu?
Louisa DuPont. That's beautiful. What was your mother's and father's name?
